item.text:
The browser source confirms a race: the dialog can resolve before the handler disables Refresh, so `!refresh.disabled` is not a reliable completion signal. I’ll arm waits for the exact owner POST and its status refresh before clicking, then assert the POST returned `accepted`.

The server changes now track enabled versus pending subscriptions by direction, keep ordinary chat off the ledger/fanout path, and derive incoming preview runes from approved source marks. I’m adding focused regression tests.

The Firestore quiet-chat test confirms exactly one dedupe read and two writes—event plus latest receipt—with no ledger access or public fanout.

The full suite is now 213 tests: 208 pass, zero failures and five sandbox loopback skips. The new browser synchronization still needs the parent’s host rerun.

Implemented all three hardening changes and corrected the browser wait race while retaining the one-POST assertion.

**213 tests: 208 pass, 5 sandbox socket skips, 0 failures.** Release inventory and diff checks pass.
